name: Chiss
description: The Chiss were a tall, blue-skinned Near-Human civilization from the planet Csilla in the Unknown Regions, best known to most Humans as the people to which Grand Admiral Thrawn belonged. Due to the isolationist position of the Chiss Ascendancy, they remained largely an enigma to the known galaxy, and contact with outsiders was limited even in the days of the Galactic Alliance.
